Maya Cheng: Quick sync — VoltEdge is asking to stack their HW credit with a Marketplace private-offer for Q3. Need policy/limits and a proposed offer grid.
Juan Alvarez: Stacking is possible but we need a hard cap on net discount. suggest <= 40% gross value; SKU-level caps required.
Dani Park: @Maya can you confirm partner legal name and whether this is channel co-sell or direct? cc @Oli for renewals impact.
Maya Cheng: Partner: VoltEdge (edge GPUs). They want: 1) $ credit applied to first invoice over 6 months, 2) joint announcement, 3) SI (CloudForge) asks for 10% services discount if their enablement commit met.
Oli Thompson: For renewals: when customer converts promo usage into reserved capacity, we must not re-issue HW credits. propose a 90-day sunset + "no retro stacking" clause.
Sri Patel: Legal: private offers must include explicit stacking rules. I'll draft a short clause: "Partner credits may be combined with Redwood offers up to a preapproved cap; all stacks require Partnerships signoff."
Dani Park: Proposed offer matrix:
```
Tier A: $250k commit -> Redwood 20% off + VoltEdge $30k credit + CloudForge 10% services credit (max stack 35%)
Tier B: $100k commit -> Redwood 12% off + VoltEdge $12k credit
Tier C: $25k commit -> Redwood 5% off + VoltEdge $3k credit
Co-marketing fund: VoltEdge provides $10k for joint PR/webinar (matching Redwood).
Notes: caps are per-customer, per-contract year. No double-crediting on renewals.
```
Juan Alvarez: Numbers look reasonable. add a discretionary escalator for >$1M ACV deals (Partnerships + Sales approval). Need to model net ARR impact in the quoting sheet.
Maya Cheng: Announcement cadence: aim for joint blog + webinar ~30 days after first production deployment. Marketing asks for assets 2 weeks prior. We should also prepare a one-pager for SIs and Sales.
Dani Park: Draft doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/partner-stack-policy (working link) — will update with the matrix.
PartnerBot: Reminder: please submit Partner Announcement PRD: /forms/partner-annc — deadline 2026-04-01 if we want April launch.
Oli Thompson: Action items: Maya confirm VoltEdge credit cadence by EOD Tue; Dani update offer doc and share spreadsheet; Sri produce draft clause; Juan own sales play & ARR impact. I'll loop in LegalOps for contract hook-ups.
Maya Cheng: ack. I'll ping VoltEdge legal and get the exact credit instrument (voucher vs invoice contra).
Juan Alvarez: Quick FYI — measure cost as effective $/token uplift in the quote so AE can see unit economics.
Dani Park: Adding one ask: SI enablement credit should be time-limited (90 days) and require a 1-hour technical onboarding to qualify.
Sri Patel: Will include onboarding clause. Also will add an approval check box in the offer template.
Oli Thompson: :thumbsup:
Maya Cheng: Thanks team. I'll consolidate and share a cleaned offer doc by tomorrow morning.
